purpose: Original static low-poly catalog candidate; not formal approval or public release.

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect eight individual512px exact-GLB views. All three identifying features must read, no visible coplanar overlap, faceted coherent surfaces, full volume. All three actual concept views inspected: consistent goblet form and negative-space windows. Concept overthick wall and texture stippling are not literal goals. Use thinner readable shell and quiet palette, retain six oval windows with gentle non-mechanical variation. Hidden stalk is evidence-informed restoration; museum pixels do not expose it.

Verify: One slender hollow stalk connected continuously to a rounded hollow goblet cup. Broad top aperture plus six oval lateral lumens, sixfold generalization with restrained shape irregularity. Continuous skeletal shell, open passages and inward-turning upper lip; no invented living soft tissues. Preserve uncertainty: Genus-level fossil-form study, not a specimen facsimile or living reconstruction. Museum cup partly infilled and eroded; hidden stalk and obscured walls restored from published stalked-cup description. Approximately20mm cup/35mm total art dimensions and0.65mm wall are stylized, not measured fossil proportions. Affinity debated; no soft tissues, spines or phylogenetic assertion.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.
